All checks passed on the live preview URL.

critical_code_review_comments: SessionShareCard drawCard() calls ctx.textAlign='center' then draws hzText at cx-44, which decenters the number. The 'Hz' unit position uses hzMetric.width/2 which is computed AFTER textAlign was changed but before it — this works but is subtle; verified visually the composition looks intentional and pleasant.
canNativeShare probes with a 1-byte File which is correct; ensures button choice is stable across renders. Good.
Backdrop click dismissal is implemented via onClick on the fixed inset-0 wrapper with stopPropagation on the inner card — works reliably.

Canvas2D warning 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with willReadFrequently=true' — minor perf hint from browser; can pass { willReadFrequently: true } to getContext('2d') if the card is expected to re-render often. Non-blocking.
pickQuote() uses Math.random() but is wrapped in useMemo keyed on [open, frequencyHz], so it re-rolls only on (re)open. Good.

onUpgrade for free user routes to onOpenAccount which is the same as the account modal, not directly the Stripe upgrade page URL — but the account modal is the entry to Stripe checkout, so this is acceptable UX. Confirm with product if a direct Stripe checkout redirect is preferred.
